Lina (Finance Ops): AuroraMeter sent a renewal quote mixing a 12mo commit + PAYG overage and a small per-seat admin fee. Can procurement/eng/legal please eyeball before we reply?
Omar (Procurement): Copy. Need itemized SKUs, whether commit can be prepaid annually, migration credit math, invoice sample (Net30 + PO field), and cancellation/refund terms.
Jules (Platform): Usage snapshot: trailing 3mo avg ~495M tokens/mo, 95th ~770M. Two heavy routes: /chat and /embed (combined ~68%). We require per-api-key attribution and a webhook example to validate our billing import.
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Hi all 44b quick summary: tiers: AM_COMMIT_400=$2,200/mo, AM_COMMIT_800=$4,000/mo, AM_COMMIT_1.4B=$8,200/mo. PAYG = $0.0072/1k tokens. Seats: ADMIN_SEAT=$650/mo. Migration credit: up to 16% of first-year committed spend on 12mo commits, applied evenly across the first 12 invoices. Annual prepay available with additional 8% off. SLA: 99.9% enterprise; 99.5 standard.
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): SKU examples: AM_COMMIT_800, AM_OVR_PAYG, AM_SEAT_ADMIN, AM_SLA_PLUS. Sample invoice will include migration credit as line item "Migration Credit" and a PO field.
Jules (Platform): Webhook example please 4dd; we need fields for customer_id, tokens, route, api_key, request_id and optional sku_hint.
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Webhook sample below:
```
POST /webhooks/usage
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "customer_id": "rw-2048",
  "timestamp": "2025-12-15T13:22:10Z",
  "tokens": 1240,
  "route": "/chat",
  "api_key": "svc-prod-11",
  "request_id": "req_5f9",
  "sku_hint": "AM_COMMIT_800"
}
```
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Monthly CSV export also available at /billing/exports?month=YYYY-MM (signed link).
Sam (Legal): Legal asks: raw request retention period, purge-on-termination option, DPA + subprocessor list, explicit 30-day non-auto-renew clause, and any termination penalty caps. Also confirm chosen billing jurisdiction and governing law.
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Default raw payload retention 60 days; billing metadata retained 7 years. We can add purge-on-termination and provide DPA + SOC2 report in the enterprise addendum. Billing jurisdiction defaults to CA but negotiable for enterprise customers; termination/refund clauses available in addendum.
Omar (Procurement): Two follow-ups: 1) Can overage be billed at a discounted rate if avg usage stays within 110% of commit? 2) Can migration credit be applied as an upfront credit (vs monthly) if we prepay annually?
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Overage discount: 10% off PAYG when monthly usage <=110% of commit. Prepay: if you annual-prepay we can apply migration credit upfront as a single credit line on month 1 (requires enterprise addendum).
Lina (Finance Ops): Quick math: if we pick AM_COMMIT_800 vs PAYG with our profile, rough monthly savings ~1.4k. Omar 4c8 can you run 2yr TCO comparing monthly commit vs annual prepay with upfront credit? Also include cashflow for seat fees.
Omar (Procurement): On it. Scheduling a 30m sync with AuroraMeter next Wed 11am PT to finalize quote details and invoice flow. @Pete confirm?
Pete (AuroraMeter Sales): Wed 11am PT works. I'll upload itemized quote, sample invoice PDF, full SKU list, DPA, webhook spec, and CSV export spec by EOD Tuesday.
Jules (Platform): Once webhook spec and CSV arrive I'll run a quick ingestion test and confirm route->SKU mapping.
Sam (Legal): Please include proposed non-auto-renew language and subprocessor list in the packet.
Lina (Finance Ops): Thanks all 44d we'll close once we have the formal quote and Omar's TCO.
